notes: FAIL on P1-1, NEW in c836d8a and a regression against 3d46d74: MAX_RENDER_DECODE_BYTES is reset per RENDER, so composite_placements gives each pane 256 MiB while composite_composed spends one 256 MiB across every pane first-come-first-served. A pane that charges the budget - 4 solid 4096x4096 PNGs, 405 KB on the wire, charged by declared s=/v= rather than payload - silently deletes a NEIGHBOUR pane's picture from window.snapshot and session.snapshot while pane.snapshot still draws it. Dose response 1/2/3 hostile -> 17100 px, 4 -> 0; the identical scene on the 3d46d74 binary keeps 17100. Order dependent: swapping the panes reverses it. Also starves within one pane, so pane.snapshot / lens glance / pane diff --heat are affected too. This breaks claim 1 of the 3d46d74 audit, the cross-path identity that 18 of the 25 committed metrics assert. The stall mitigation itself is real and independently measured (802 ms -> 368 ms at 24 placements); the defect is the budget's SCOPE. Budgeting per pane inside composite_composed restores identity by construction. Secondary: P2-1 the budget's accumulation branch is reached by zero tests (M16b survived); P2-2 the 'kitten icat photo decodes to ~1 MB' figure in the source is ~10x optimistic - measured 9.27 MiB for a real icat into a 200x55 pane.
